question: Who among the following was a Padma Bhushan awardee, legendary Bharatanatyam exponent, theosophist and founder of the Kalakshetra Dance School?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rukmini Devi Arundale.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rukmini Devi Arundale:-**

 
 
• She​ was a** legendary Bharatanatyam exponent**,** theosophist**, and founder of the** Kalakshetra Dance School**, which is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• She was awarded the **Padma Bhushan** award in **1956** for her contributions to dance and education.
 
• Arundale was also a prominent** animal welfare activist** and was instrumental in the establishment of the** Animal Welfare Board of India.**
 
• She was a disciple of Annie Besant and was deeply influenced by theosophy, which played a significant role in shaping her worldview and approach to dance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sonal Mansingh:-**

 
 
• She is a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer who has been awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, the second-highest civilian award in India.
 
• She is known for her expertise in several dance forms, including **Bharatanatyam, Odissi, and Kuchipudi.**
 
 
 
• **Saroja Vaidyanathan:-**
 
 
• She is a well-known Bharatanatyam dancer and guru who has been honored with several awards, including the** Padma Shri **and the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
• She is the founder of **Ganesa Natyalaya,** a dance school in Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai:-**
 
 
• She is a **contemporary dancer and choreographer **who has also acted in films and television shows.
 
• She is the daughter of renowned classical dancer** Mrinalini Sarabhai **and the famous **physicist Vikram Sarabhai.**
 
• She has been awarded the **Padma Shri** for her contributions to the field of performing arts.
